SELECT * FROM (
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT '${PAGE_DATE_STATUS03}' statusValid, T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID busiCode, T1.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, T5.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName, T1.FINPROD_ID finprodId, T41.TRADE_DATE tradeDate, T4.IRS_TYPE irsType, T4.VDATE vdate, T4.MDATE mdate, T4.CCY ccy, T1.REMAIN_PRIN/10000 restPrin, T1.TG_BUSI_TYPE pridBussType, case when T1.TG_BUSI_TYPE = '${TG_BUSI_TYPE_beforeEnd}' then null else T1.PS end irsPsIntType, T2.SETTLE_DATE fixActPayDate, T2.VDATE fixVdate, T2.MDATE fixMdate, T2.TRADE_AMT fixIntAmt, T3.SETTLE_DATE floatActPayDate, T3.VDATE floatVdate, T3.MDATE floatMdate, T3.TRADE_AMT floatIntAmt, case when T1.TG_BUSI_TYPE = '${TG_BUSI_TYPE_beforeEnd}' then T1.TRADE_DATE else null end beforeEndDate, case when T1.TG_BUSI_TYPE = '${TG_BUSI_TYPE_beforeEnd}' then T1.SHARE_AMT else null end beforeEndPrin, case when T1.TG_BUSI_TYPE = '${TG_BUSI_TYPE_beforeEnd}' then T1.PS else null end beforeEndPs, case when T1.TG_BUSI_TYPE = '${TG_BUSI_TYPE_beforeEnd}' then T1.TRADE_AMT else null end beforeEndAmt, case when T1.TG_BUSI_TYPE = '${TG_BUSI_TYPE_beforeEnd}' then T1.SETTLE_DATE else null end beforeEndPayDate, T1.REMARK remark, T1.WORKFLOW_ID workflowId, T4.TERM term, T4.PRIN/10000 prin, T4.COUNTER_ID counterId, T8.PAY_DATE fixPayDate, T2.CASH_ID fixCashId, T10.PAY_DATE floatPayDate, T3.CASH_ID floatCashId FROM WFL_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL T1
LEFT JOIN FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT T4 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T4.FINPROD_ID AND T1.BRANCH = T4.BRANCH LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T41 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T41.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T2 ON T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = T2.TOTLE_TRADE_ID
AND ((T2.PS = #{psR} and T4.IRS_TYPE = #{irsType01}) OR (T2.PS = #{psP} and T4.IRS_TYPE = #{irsType02})) LEFT JOIN WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T3 ON T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = T3.TOTLE_TRADE_ID AND ((T3.PS = #{psR} and T4.IRS_TYPE = #{irsType02}) OR (T3.PS = #{psP} and T4.IRS_TYPE = #{irsType01})) LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO T5 ON T5.PORTFOLIO_ID = T1.PORTFOLIO_ID
LEFT JOIN (select distinct T6.CASH_ID,T6.FINPROD_ID,T6.BRANCH,T6.FINPROD_TYPE from FIN_CASH_INFO T6, FIN_RATE_INFO T7 where T7.CASH_ID = T6.CASH_ID AND T7.INT_TYPE = #{rateTypeFix}) T7 ON T7.FINPROD_ID = T4.FINPROD_ID AND T7.BRANCH = T4.BRANCH AND T7.FINPROD_TYPE = #{cashBussType} LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_PLAN T8 ON T8.CASH_ID = T7.CASH_ID AND T8.MDATE = T2.MDATE LEFT JOIN (select distinct T6.CASH_ID,T6.FINPROD_ID,T6.BRANCH,T6.FINPROD_TYPE from FIN_CASH_INFO T6, FIN_RATE_INFO T9 where T9.CASH_ID = T6.CASH_ID AND T9.INT_TYPE = #{rateTypeFloat}) T9 ON T9.FINPROD_ID = T4.FINPROD_ID AND T9.BRANCH = T4.BRANCH AND T9.FINPROD_TYPE = #{cashBussType} LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_PLAN T10 ON T10.CASH_ID = T9.CASH_ID AND T10.MDATE = T3.MDATE
WHERE T4.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE_TGF14} AND T1.P_TRADE_ID IS NULL AND T1.P_TOTLE_TRADE_ID IS NULL
AND T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{busiCode}
AND ( T5.PORTFOLIO_ID IN
#{item}
or T5.PARENT_PORTFOLIO_ID IN
#{item}
)
AND T1.PORTFOLIO_ID ORDER BY T1.MDATE DESC )
UNION ALL
SELECT T0.statusValid, T0.busiCode, T0.portfolioId, T0.portfolioName, T0.finprodId, T0.tradeDate, T0.irsType, T0.vdate, T0.mdate, T0.ccy, T0.restPrin, T0.pridBussType, T0.irsPsIntType, T0.fixActPayDate, T0.fixVdate, T0.fixMdate, CASE WHEN irsPsIntType IN ('${irsPsIntType01}','${irsPsIntType05}') THEN PSV.IN_TDY_INTINCEXP ELSE PSV.OUT_TDY_INTINCEXP END fixIntAmt, T0.floatActPayDate, T0.floatVdate, T0.floatMdate, CASE WHEN irsPsIntType IN ('${irsPsIntType03}','${irsPsIntType06}') THEN PSV.IN_TDY_INTINCEXP ELSE PSV.OUT_TDY_INTINCEXP END floatIntAmt, T0.beforeEndDate, T0.beforeEndPrin, T0.beforeEndPs, T0.beforeEndAmt, null beforeEndPayDate, T0.remark, T0.workflowId, T0.term, T0.prin, T0.counterId, T0.fixPayDate, T0.fixCashId, T0.floatPayDate, T0.floatCashId FROM ( SELECT T.*, nvl(T.fixMdate, T.floatMdate) fixFloatMdate, RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY T.finprodId, T.fixCashId ORDER BY T.fixMdate) fixNum, RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY T.finprodId, T.floatCashId ORDER BY T.floatMdate) floatNum FROM (
select '${PAGE_DATE_STATUS01}' statusValid, null busiCode, T1.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, T5.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName, T1.FINPROD_ID finprodId, T41.TRADE_DATE tradeDate, T4.IRS_TYPE irsType, T4.VDATE vdate, T4.MDATE mdate, T4.CCY ccy, T1.AMOUNT/10000 restPrin, CASE WHEN T8.MDATE < T4.MDATE THEN '${pridBussType01}' ELSE '${pridBussType02}' END pridBussType, CASE WHEN T4.IRS_TYPE='${irsType01}' THEN '${irsPsIntType01}' ELSE '${irsPsIntType02}' END irsPsIntType, T8.PAY_DATE fixActPayDate, T8.VDATE fixVdate, T8.MDATE fixMdate, null fixIntAmt, T10.PAY_DATE floatActPayDate, T10.VDATE floatVdate, T10.MDATE floatMdate, null floatIntAmt, null beforeEndDate, null beforeEndPrin, null beforeEndPs, null beforeEndAmt, null remark, NULL workflowId, T4.TERM term, T4.PRIN/10000 prin, T4.COUNTER_ID counterId, T8.PAY_DATE fixPayDate, T8.CASH_ID fixCashId, T10.PAY_DATE floatPayDate, T10.CASH_ID floatCashId, T5.PARENT_PORTFOLIO_ID parentPortfolioId FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION T1 LEFT JOIN FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT T4 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T4.FINPROD_ID AND T1.BRANCH = T4.BRANCH LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T41 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T41.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN (select distinct T6.CASH_ID,T6.FINPROD_ID,T6.BRANCH,T6.FINPROD_TYPE from FIN_CASH_INFO T6, FIN_RATE_INFO T7 where T7.CASH_ID = T6.CASH_ID AND T7.INT_TYPE = #{rateTypeFix}) T7
ON T7.FINPROD_ID = T4.FINPROD_ID AND T7.BRANCH = T4.BRANCH AND T7.FINPROD_TYPE = #{cashBussType}
LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_PLAN T8 ON T8.CASH_ID = T7.CASH_ID LEFT JOIN (select distinct T6.CASH_ID,T6.FINPROD_ID,T6.BRANCH,T6.FINPROD_TYPE from FIN_CASH_INFO T6, FIN_RATE_INFO T9 where T9.CASH_ID = T6.CASH_ID AND T9.INT_TYPE = #{rateTypeFloat}) T9 ON T9.FINPROD_ID = T4.FINPROD_ID AND T9.BRANCH = T4.BRANCH AND T9.FINPROD_TYPE = #{cashBussType} LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_PLAN T10
ON T10.CASH_ID = T9.CASH_ID AND T8.MDATE = T10.MDATE AND T8.PAY_DATE = T10.PAY_DATE LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO T5 ON T5.PORTFOLIO_ID = T1.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T11 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T11.FINPROD_ID AND T11.TOTLE_TRADE_ID IS NOT NULL AND T11.MDATE = nvl(T8.MDATE, T10.MDATE) AND T11.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS01} AND T11.IS_CANCEL = #{YESNO_N} LEFT JOIN WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T12 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T12.FINPROD_ID AND T12.TOTLE_TRADE_ID IS NOT NULL AND T12.MDATE = nvl(T8.MDATE, T10.MDATE) WHERE T4.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE_TGF14} AND T1.AMOUNT > 0 AND T5.INVEST_YESORNO='Y' AND T10.MDATE is null AND T11.MDATE is null AND T12.MDATE is null
AND 1 = 0
AND T1.PORTFOLIO_ID
UNION ALL
select '${PAGE_DATE_STATUS01}' statusValid, null busiCode, T1.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, T5.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName, T1.FINPROD_ID finprodId, T41.TRADE_DATE tradeDate, T4.IRS_TYPE irsType, T4.VDATE vdate, T4.MDATE mdate, T4.CCY ccy, T1.AMOUNT/10000 restPrin, case when T10.MDATE < T4.MDATE THEN '${pridBussType01}' else '${pridBussType02}' end pridBussType, CASE WHEN T4.IRS_TYPE='${irsType01}' THEN '${irsPsIntType04}' ELSE '${irsPsIntType03}' END irsPsIntType, T8.PAY_DATE fixActPayDate, T8.VDATE fixVdate, T8.MDATE fixMdate, null fixIntAmt, T10.PAY_DATE floatActPayDate, T10.VDATE floatVdate, T10.MDATE floatMdate, null floatIntAmt, null beforeEndDate, null beforeEndPrin, null beforeEndPs, null beforeEndAmt, null remark, NULL workflowId, T4.TERM term, T4.PRIN/10000 prin, T4.COUNTER_ID counterId, T8.PAY_DATE fixPayDate, T8.CASH_ID fixCashId, T10.PAY_DATE floatPayDate, T10.CASH_ID floatCashId, T5.PARENT_PORTFOLIO_ID parentPortfolioId FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION T1 LEFT JOIN FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT T4 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T4.FINPROD_ID AND T1.BRANCH = T4.BRANCH LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T41 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T41.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN (select distinct T6.CASH_ID,T6.FINPROD_ID,T6.BRANCH,T6.FINPROD_TYPE from FIN_CASH_INFO T6, FIN_RATE_INFO T7 where T7.CASH_ID = T6.CASH_ID AND T7.INT_TYPE = #{rateTypeFix}) T7 ON T7.FINPROD_ID = T4.FINPROD_ID AND T7.BRANCH = T4.BRANCH AND T7.FINPROD_TYPE = #{cashBussType} LEFT JOIN (select distinct T6.CASH_ID,T6.FINPROD_ID,T6.BRANCH,T6.FINPROD_TYPE from FIN_CASH_INFO T6, FIN_RATE_INFO T9 where T9.CASH_ID = T6.CASH_ID AND T9.INT_TYPE = #{rateTypeFloat}) T9 ON T9.FINPROD_ID = T4.FINPROD_ID AND T9.BRANCH = T4.BRANCH AND T9.FINPROD_TYPE = #{cashBussType} LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_PLAN T10
ON T10.CASH_ID = T9.CASH_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_PLAN T8
ON T8.CASH_ID = T7.CASH_ID AND T8.MDATE = T10.MDATE AND T8.PAY_DATE = T10.PAY_DATE LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO T5 ON T5.PORTFOLIO_ID = T1.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T11 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T11.FINPROD_ID AND T11.TOTLE_TRADE_ID IS NOT NULL AND T11.MDATE = nvl(T8.MDATE, T10.MDATE) AND T11.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS01} AND T11.IS_CANCEL = #{YESNO_N} LEFT JOIN WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T12 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T12.FINPROD_ID AND T12.TOTLE_TRADE_ID IS NOT NULL AND T12.MDATE = nvl(T8.MDATE, T10.MDATE) WHERE T4.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE_TGF14} AND T1.AMOUNT > 0 AND T5.INVEST_YESORNO='Y' AND T8.MDATE is null AND T11.MDATE is null AND T12.MDATE is null
AND 1 = 0
AND T1.PORTFOLIO_ID
UNION ALL
select '${PAGE_DATE_STATUS01}' statusValid, null busiCode, T1.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, T5.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName, T1.FINPROD_ID finprodId, T41.TRADE_DATE tradeDate, T4.IRS_TYPE irsType, T4.VDATE vdate, T4.MDATE mdate, T4.CCY ccy, T1.AMOUNT/10000 restPrin, case when T8.MDATE < T4.MDATE THEN '${pridBussType01}' else '${pridBussType02}' end pridBussType, '${irsPsIntType06}' irsPsIntType, T8.PAY_DATE fixActPayDate, T8.VDATE fixVdate, T8.MDATE fixMdate, null fixIntAmt, T10.PAY_DATE floatActPayDate, T10.VDATE floatVdate, T10.MDATE floatMdate, null floatIntAmt, null beforeEndDate, null beforeEndPrin, null beforeEndPs, null beforeEndAmt, null remark, NULL workflowId, T4.TERM term, T4.PRIN/10000 prin, T4.COUNTER_ID counterId, T8.PAY_DATE fixPayDate, T8.CASH_ID fixCashId, T10.PAY_DATE floatPayDate, T10.CASH_ID floatCashId, T5.PARENT_PORTFOLIO_ID parentPortfolioId FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION T1 LEFT JOIN FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT T4 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T4.FINPROD_ID AND T1.BRANCH = T4.BRANCH LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T41 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T41.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN (select distinct T6.CASH_ID,T6.FINPROD_ID,T6.BRANCH,T6.FINPROD_TYPE from FIN_CASH_INFO T6, FIN_RATE_INFO T7 where T7.CASH_ID = T6.CASH_ID AND T7.INT_TYPE = #{rateTypeFix}) T7 ON T7.FINPROD_ID = T4.FINPROD_ID AND T7.BRANCH = T4.BRANCH AND T7.FINPROD_TYPE = #{cashBussType} LEFT JOIN (select distinct T6.CASH_ID,T6.FINPROD_ID,T6.BRANCH,T6.FINPROD_TYPE from FIN_CASH_INFO T6, FIN_RATE_INFO T9 where T9.CASH_ID = T6.CASH_ID AND T9.INT_TYPE = #{rateTypeFloat}) T9 ON T9.FINPROD_ID = T4.FINPROD_ID AND T9.BRANCH = T4.BRANCH AND T9.FINPROD_TYPE = #{cashBussType} LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_PLAN T10
ON T10.CASH_ID = T9.CASH_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_PLAN T8
ON T8.CASH_ID = T7.CASH_ID AND T8.MDATE = T10.MDATE AND T8.PAY_DATE = T10.PAY_DATE LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO T5 ON T5.PORTFOLIO_ID = T1.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T11 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T11.FINPROD_ID AND T11.TOTLE_TRADE_ID IS NOT NULL AND T11.MDATE = nvl(T8.MDATE, T10.MDATE) AND T11.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS01} AND T11.IS_CANCEL = #{YESNO_N} LEFT JOIN WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T12 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T12.FINPROD_ID AND T12.TOTLE_TRADE_ID IS NOT NULL AND T12.MDATE = nvl(T8.MDATE, T10.MDATE) WHERE T4.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE_TGF14} AND T4.IRS_TYPE = #{irsType02} AND T1.AMOUNT > 0 AND T5.INVEST_YESORNO='Y' AND T8.MDATE is not null AND T10.MDATE is not null AND T11.MDATE is null AND T12.MDATE is null
AND 1 = 0
AND T1.PORTFOLIO_ID
UNION ALL
select '${PAGE_DATE_STATUS01}' statusValid, null busiCode, T1.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, T5.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName, T1.FINPROD_ID finprodId, T41.TRADE_DATE tradeDate, T4.IRS_TYPE irsType, T4.VDATE vdate, T4.MDATE mdate, T4.CCY ccy, T1.AMOUNT/10000 restPrin, case when T8.MDATE < T4.MDATE THEN '${pridBussType01}' else '${pridBussType02}' end pridBussType, '${irsPsIntType05}' irsPsIntType, T8.PAY_DATE fixActPayDate, T8.VDATE fixVdate, T8.MDATE fixMdate, null fixIntAmt, T10.PAY_DATE floatActPayDate, T10.VDATE floatVdate, T10.MDATE floatMdate, null floatIntAmt, null beforeEndDate, null beforeEndPrin, null beforeEndPs, null beforeEndAmt, null remark, NULL workflowId, T4.TERM term, T4.PRIN/10000 prin, T4.COUNTER_ID counterId, T8.PAY_DATE fixPayDate, T8.CASH_ID fixCashId, T10.PAY_DATE floatPayDate, T10.CASH_ID floatCashId, T5.PARENT_PORTFOLIO_ID parentPortfolioId FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION T1 LEFT JOIN FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT T4 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T4.FINPROD_ID AND T1.BRANCH = T4.BRANCH LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T41 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T41.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN (select distinct T6.CASH_ID,T6.FINPROD_ID,T6.BRANCH,T6.FINPROD_TYPE from FIN_CASH_INFO T6, FIN_RATE_INFO T7 where T7.CASH_ID = T6.CASH_ID AND T7.INT_TYPE = #{rateTypeFix}) T7 ON T7.FINPROD_ID = T4.FINPROD_ID AND T7.BRANCH = T4.BRANCH AND T7.FINPROD_TYPE = #{cashBussType} LEFT JOIN (select distinct T6.CASH_ID,T6.FINPROD_ID,T6.BRANCH,T6.FINPROD_TYPE from FIN_CASH_INFO T6, FIN_RATE_INFO T9 where T9.CASH_ID = T6.CASH_ID AND T9.INT_TYPE = #{rateTypeFloat}) T9 ON T9.FINPROD_ID = T4.FINPROD_ID AND T9.BRANCH = T4.BRANCH AND T9.FINPROD_TYPE = #{cashBussType} LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_PLAN T10 ON T10.CASH_ID = T9.CASH_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_PLAN T8
ON T8.CASH_ID = T7.CASH_ID AND T8.MDATE = T10.MDATE AND T8.PAY_DATE = T10.PAY_DATE LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO T5 ON T5.PORTFOLIO_ID = T1.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T11 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T11.FINPROD_ID AND T11.TOTLE_TRADE_ID IS NOT NULL AND T11.MDATE = nvl(T8.MDATE, T10.MDATE) AND T11.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS01} AND T11.IS_CANCEL = #{YESNO_N} LEFT JOIN WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T12 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T12.FINPROD_ID AND T12.TOTLE_TRADE_ID IS NOT NULL AND T12.MDATE = nvl(T8.MDATE, T10.MDATE) WHERE T4.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE_TGF14} AND T4.IRS_TYPE = #{irsType01} AND T1.AMOUNT > 0 AND T5.INVEST_YESORNO='Y' AND T8.MDATE is not null AND T10.MDATE is not null AND T11.MDATE is null AND T12.MDATE is null
AND 1 = 0
AND T1.PORTFOLIO_ID ) T
ORDER BY fixFloatMdate DESC ) T0 left join PTL_SEC_VALUTION PSV on T0.finprodId = PSV.FINPROD_ID and nvl(T0.parentPortfolioId, T0.portfolioId) = PSV.PORTFOLIO_ID and T0.fixFloatMdate = PSV.CDATE + 1 day where (T0.fixCashId is not null and T0.fixNum = 1) or (T0.floatCashId is not null and T0.floatNum = 1)
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT '${PAGE_DATE_STATUS05}' statusValid, T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID busiCode, PTL.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, PTL.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName, T1.FINPROD_ID finprodId, T41.TRADE_DATE tradeDate, T4.IRS_TYPE irsType, T4.VDATE vdate, T4.MDATE mdate, T4.CCY ccy, T1.REMAIN_PRIN/10000 restPrin, T1.TG_BUSI_TYPE pridBussType, case when T1.TG_BUSI_TYPE = '${TG_BUSI_TYPE_beforeEnd}' then null else T1.PS end irsPsIntType, T2.SETTLE_DATE fixActPayDate, T2.VDATE fixVdate, T2.MDATE fixMdate, T2.TRADE_AMT fixIntAmt, T3.SETTLE_DATE floatActPayDate, T3.VDATE floatVdate, T3.MDATE floatMdate, T3.TRADE_AMT floatIntAmt, case when T1.TG_BUSI_TYPE = '${TG_BUSI_TYPE_beforeEnd}' then T1.TRADE_DATE else null end beforeEndDate, case when T1.TG_BUSI_TYPE = '${TG_BUSI_TYPE_beforeEnd}' then T1.SHARE_AMT else null end beforeEndPrin, case when T1.TG_BUSI_TYPE = '${TG_BUSI_TYPE_beforeEnd}' then T1.PS else null end beforeEndPs, case when T1.TG_BUSI_TYPE = '${TG_BUSI_TYPE_beforeEnd}' then T1.TRADE_AMT else null end beforeEndAmt, case when T1.TG_BUSI_TYPE = '${TG_BUSI_TYPE_beforeEnd}' then T1.SETTLE_DATE else null end beforeEndPayDate, T1.REMARK remark, null workflowId, T4.TERM term, T4.PRIN/10000 prin, T4.COUNTER_ID counterId, T8.PAY_DATE fixPayDate, T2.CASH_ID fixCashId, T10.PAY_DATE floatPayDate, T3.CASH_ID floatCashId FROM TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL T1
LEFT JOIN FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT T4 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T4.FINPROD_ID AND T1.BRANCH = T4.BRANCH LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T41 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T41.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T2 ON T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = T2.TOTLE_TRADE_ID
AND ((T2.PS = #{psR} and T4.IRS_TYPE = #{irsType01}) OR (T2.PS = #{psP} and T4.IRS_TYPE = #{irsType02})) LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T3 ON T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = T3.TOTLE_TRADE_ID AND ((T3.PS = #{psR} and T4.IRS_TYPE = #{irsType02}) OR (T3.PS = #{psP} and T4.IRS_TYPE = #{irsType01})) LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO T5 ON T5.PORTFOLIO_ID = T1.PORTFOLIO_ID
LEFT JOIN (select distinct T6.CASH_ID,T6.FINPROD_ID,T6.BRANCH,T6.FINPROD_TYPE from FIN_CASH_INFO T6, FIN_RATE_INFO T7 where T7.CASH_ID = T6.CASH_ID AND T7.INT_TYPE = #{rateTypeFix}) T7 ON T7.FINPROD_ID = T4.FINPROD_ID AND T7.BRANCH = T4.BRANCH AND T7.FINPROD_TYPE = #{cashBussType} LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_PLAN T8 ON T8.CASH_ID = T7.CASH_ID AND T8.MDATE = T2.MDATE LEFT JOIN (select distinct T6.CASH_ID,T6.FINPROD_ID,T6.BRANCH,T6.FINPROD_TYPE from FIN_CASH_INFO T6, FIN_RATE_INFO T9 where T9.CASH_ID = T6.CASH_ID AND T9.INT_TYPE = #{rateTypeFloat}) T9 ON T9.FINPROD_ID = T4.FINPROD_ID AND T9.BRANCH = T4.BRANCH AND T9.FINPROD_TYPE = #{cashBussType} LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_PLAN T10 ON T10.CASH_ID = T9.CASH_ID AND T10.MDATE = T3.MDATE
LEFT JOIN PTL_TRADE PT ON NVL(NVL(T2.P_TRADE_ID, T2.TRADE_ID), NVL(T3.P_TRADE_ID, T3.TRADE_ID)) = PT.BUSI_NO LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO PTL ON PT.PORTFOLIO_ID = PTL.PORTFOLIO_ID WHERE T1.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS01} AND T1.IS_CANCEL = #{YESNO_N} AND T4.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE_TGF14} AND PTL.INVEST_YESORNO='Y' AND T1.P_TRADE_ID IS NULL/*撤销的数据不展示*/ AND T1.P_TOTLE_TRADE_ID IS NULL
AND T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{busiCode}
AND ( PTL.PORTFOLIO_ID IN
#{item}
or PTL.PARENT_PORTFOLIO_ID IN
#{item}
)
